snippet.title: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5364850/Doomward_Dungeon_Autobattler/

The Doom Herald is waking. Your guild has until the clock runs out.

Doomward is a roguelike autobattler where you never swing a sword. Every fight plays itself. You win before it starts: who you hire, how you specialize them, what they wear, and the rules they follow once the blades come out.

- Build a guild from a deep roster of classes and specializations, then write their battle rules
- Chain combos: freeze, then shatter; oil, then ignite
- Race the Doom Clock across many kinds of place, with branching paths, traps, treasure and contracts worth the risk
- Defend your town from Harbinger sieges. Lose one and the run is over
- Face the Herald, a raid boss fought in phases, with a random Doombreaker ultimate on your side
- Daily and Weekly challenges with Steam leaderboards, and Edicts to twist every run
- HARDCORE mode: a hero who dies stays dead for the run, with its own leaderboards
- Co-op for 1-4 players and PvP (1v1 and 2v2) through Steam, LAN or Direct Connect
- Full controller support with a dedicated controller GUI, Steam Deck ready
- Steam Achievements and Cloud saves

Release date: October 21, 2026 on Steam (Windows)
Developer and publisher: Mire Studios

#Doomward #Autobattler #Roguelike
